feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 October 2026 10:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 06 October 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system over north Wales and northern England will move away southeastwards, leaving a northwest airstream in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North 3 or 4, increasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 tonight, further increasing Northwest 5 or 6 early tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Patchy rain clearing to scattered showers overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow night or at first on Thursday morning. Backing West or Northwest 3 or 4 later in morning, then South or Southwest 4 or 5 in the afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight on Thursday afternoon, building moderate in the evening.


##Weather##

Scattered showers soon becoming isolated, rain arriving from west on Thursday afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers and in rain later.
